title: AI and History Conference 2026 -- Registration
description: Johns Hopkins University, October 15-16, 2026. An official conference of the American Historical Association. Everyone is welcome to register.

items.title: B. Registration Fee
items.description: The registration fee is $100 for faculty and professionals. Graduate students and anyone for whom the fee would be a financial barrier attend free of charge, no documentation needed. You will receive a payment link in the near future by email.

items.title: D. Tell Us About Your Work
items.description: These questions help us curate sessions, assign seats at meals, and ensure the conference serves a range of backgrounds and interests.

items.title: 1. Why are you interested in attending the AI and History Conference?
2. How would you describe your experience with computational or AI methods in historical research?
options: New to this — curious but little or no hands-on experience
Getting started — experimented with tools but not yet confident
Advanced — develop or teach computational methods

items.title: 3. Which of the following methods or tools have you used in your research?
options: Large language models (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) for research tasks
Text mining or natural language processing (Python, R, etc.)

items.title: 4. What is your primary research area or period?
5. Is there a specific session topic, tool, or question you would most like to see addressed at the conference?
6. Is there a question you would like to ask the whole conference?
